overview: The Sanctum of Echoes is the Basilica’s inner research and containment complex for void resonance echoes.
history: Luclinite arcane orders carved the Sanctum to isolate resonance phenomena.
Echo conduits were installed to route energy from the Basilica’s core.
Arcane vaults were built to store dangerous resonance artifacts.
Echo‑born entities formed from unstable experiments.
Akhevan forces now attempt to breach the Sanctum’s defenses.
hooks: An echo conduit begins to overload.
A resonance vault seal fails unexpectedly.
